scope: Actual production public React UI with isolated synthetic catalog/auth responses. Not live providers, account creation or physical devices.

results.name: Hero sequence uses shared timing; headline stays opaque and focused CTA settles immediately
Scroll compositions reveal once; repeated scrolling and feature anchors neither replay nor request private data
Screenshot tabs retain keyboard selection; native FAQ opens/closes immediately during motion
Five widths retain first-viewport CTA, no overflow, axe checks, touch menu, Escape/focus and actual anchor indication
Dark surfaces remain accessible; reduced motion cancels running effects, disconnects observer and avoids new entrances
Signup/Pro destinations work during entrances; leaving cleans up animation/observer without AI, content or billing writes
Without IntersectionObserver or JavaScript, prerendered copy/CTA and native FAQ stay visible and functional
